news.title: Children kidnapped: Atlanta suspect accused of similar crime in Alabama
news.summary: Atlanta Police said the woman accused of kidnapping two young children had been accused of a nearly identical crime in Alabama five years ago.

news.title: Georgia man accused of running $165 million crypto Ponzi scheme, arrested in Fiji
news.summary: The U.S. Attorney's Office in Atlanta said Monday that Edward Zimbardi will face wire fraud and money laundering charges.

news.title: 2 sisters found safe after babysitter abducted them, family says
news.summary: Atlanta Police said two children who had been reported kidnapped were safely found Monday.

news.title: Woman fights back sexual assault attempt near downtown Senoia, police say
news.summary: Police in Senoia are asking for help if anyone saw a suspicious man or anything else odd in the area on Sunday night after a woman reported an attempted assault.

news.title: 2 missing Atlanta sisters found, babysitter arrested for kidnapping
news.summary: 4-year-old Zola Cooper and her 11-month-old sister, Norah Cooper, were reported missing by their family.

news.title: Lil' Toonk denied bond in 2024 shooting that left 17-year-old dead in Atlanta
news.summary: The charge stems from an attempted armed robbery near the Georgia Tech campus in 2024. The incident left 17-year-old Ja' Vuntae Vaughn dead.

news.title: Organizer for massive crypto Ponzi scheme arrested, Atlanta feds say
news.summary: The alleged organizer of a massive cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme is in federal custody after authorities say they spent more than two years tracking him around the world.

news.title: Atlanta police officer shot in arm responding to mental health crisis; suspect in custody
news.summary: Mayor Andre Dickens and Police Chief Darin Schierbaum gave details on the situation in an update outside Grady Hospital on Monday morning.

news.title: Atlanta police officer shot in arm during call, police say
news.summary: An Atlanta police officer is expected to recover after being shot while responding to a call involving an armed person experiencing a mental health crisis Monday morning, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Mother's boyfriend now facing murder charge after 2-year-old's body found in Marietta
news.summary: 23-year-old Darian Keith was previously charged with two felony charges of concealing a death and making false statements.

news.title: Sandy Springs shooting leaves 2 injured, including suspect who police say shot himself
news.summary: Two people were shot Saturday morning on Roswell Rd in Sandy Springs, as police investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident.
